_comment: Single source of truth for the Blender nodes skill environment. Always reference this file; do not hardcode these paths anywhere else.

python._role: External Python (the one running outside Blender): executes all glue scripts that do not touch bpy; third-party geometry libraries are installed here
python._exe_note: This is your own external Python path，(on Windows, this means it must end with python.exe).
python.exe: -----Fill in the full path. Backslashes must be doubled. Example: C:\Users\you\Python313\python.exe-----\python.exe
python.site_packages_hint: numpy / scipy / trimesh / pyvista / manifold3d / matplotlib / PIL

blender._role: Inner environment: every script that needs bpy must be run through it (--background, no GUI)
blender._exe_note: This is your own Blender 4.5 path,The path must point to the Blender executable (on Windows, this means it must end with blender.exe).
blender.exe: -----Fill in the full path. Backslashes must be doubled. Example: C:\Users\you\blender-4.5.0-windows-x64-----\blender.exe
blender._note: Note: this points to blender.exe, NOT the python.exe inside its folder.

workspace._role: Workspace: where .blend files, batch files, payloads, generated scripts and other runtime artifacts are written (Python side reads it via envcard.WORKSPACE; TS side reads this file directly)
workspace._root_note: This is your own workspace path.
workspace.root: -----Fill in the full path. Backslashes must be doubled. Example: C:\Users\you\workspace-----
